inlines.v: PERTURB' PER'TURBATE, verb transitive [Latin perturbo; per and turbo, properly to turn, or to stir by turning.] 1. To disturb; to agitate; to disquiet. 2. To disorder; to confuse. [This verb is little used. The participle is in use.]
